Commentary.Commentary: India will be relatively happy with their effort despite the late heroics from Southee who struck his maiden ODI fifty. Latham was the lone fighter for New Zealand and he carried his bat through, becoming the 10th player overall to do so and the first one from New Zealand. The Kiwis will feel they still have a decent score to bowl at here and will hope to take new ball wickets to put pressure on India. Do join us in a short while for the chase.

New Zealand have comeback well after being 65 for 7 to post this total here in Dharamsala in the first ODI of the series. The pace bowlers struck early for India with Hardik Pandya taking 3 at the beginning. The spinners were not quite effective enough and the lower order then struck some vital runs for the Kiwis.

OUT! That is it for the Black Caps! Googly outside off from Mishra, Sodhi stays in the crease and looks to cut that one but misses and the ball spins in, hitting him on the pads. That is an easy decision for the umpire who raises his finger. NEW ZEALAND ARE ALL OUT FOR 190!
Kedar Jadhav comes in at silly point under the helmet.
Tossed up outside off, very slow ball, defended off the front foot.
Full outside off, Latham charges forward and drives it through long off for a single.
SIX! New Zealand have something to smile about now! Full on middle and off, Latham slog sweeps it over square leg and the ball disappears into the crowd.
FOUR! Floated around off, Latham steps forward and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary.
Yorker on middle, Sodhi does well to dig it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the backfoot.
Short ball on off, played awkwardly to mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, played to point.
In the corridor outside off, left alone.

OUT! Full on the stumps, Southee steps forward and looks to loft it. He doesn't get his timing right and the ball takes a top edge. Manish Pandey back-pedals from the covers and takes the catch. That ends a brilliant batting innings by Southee!
FOUR! Well played! Length ball outside off, Southee opens the face of his bat and helps it to the third man boundary.
Southee is ensuring New Zealand have a score to bowl at here. Can Mishra provide the breakthrough?
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Floated up outside off, Latham gets a slight top edge and the ball goes over the square leg fence for a boundary.
Latham has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another flatter one on middle, worked down the leg side for a single.
Flatter delivery, Southee shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Southee tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Full on middle and off, Latham sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Maiden ODI fifty Tim Southee!
Fuller ball on the stumps, worked down the leg side for a single. That is a very well deserved half-century for Southee!
Length ball outside off, Southee looks to play it but the ball takes an inside edge and hits his pads. The batsmen run a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Length ball on the pads and Southee half-pulls it again. The ball races to square leg again and the fielder in the deep is powerless to stop it.
50-run stand up between Southee and Latham!
SIX! Back of a length ball on leg, Southee picks it up beautifully, flicking it over long leg and into the stands for a maximum.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to wide mid on for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Fullish ball on off, driven through mid off for a single.
Yadav is back on.
Quicker ball down the leg side, Southee looks to play but is struck on the thigh-pad.
Fuller outside off, pushed to the covers.
Sliding in from outside off, Southee fails to put bat on ball.

Landed on the pads, flicked off the pads for a couple. There was a chance of a run-out but Kedar running from short fine leg is late to spot that two batsmen are at the same end. Dhoni is not happy one bit with Kedar and asks him to keep an eye.
FOUR! Delicately done! Down the leg side, Southee glances it down to fine leg for a boundary.

Tossed up outside off, keeps a touch low as Southee looks to play it but misses and the ball goes behind the stumps but the fielder at third man runs in to stop it. The batsmen run two but the umpire signals leg byes.
Fuller ball outside off, driven to long off for a single.
SIX! SMASHED! Second maximum for Southee! Full toss around off, Southee lofts that one with the angle and it arcs over long on for a maximum.
Landed outside off, played to point.
Loopy ball on off, pushed to point.
Full on middle and off, Latham opens the face of his bat and pushes it to the covers for a single.
Full outside off, defeneded off the front foot to the off side.
SIX! Going, going, gone! Southee slinks down the wicket and lofts it down the ground over the head of the bowler for a 91m maximum. Superb strike.
Southee defends this one off his crease.
Short outside off, Southee misses his attempted cut.

Up in the air and... DROPPED! Short ball on the stumps, Southee looks to pull it but the ball takes the top edge. Missed opportunity for India and Bumrah does not look happy!
Back of a length ball outside off,  Southee attempts to put bat on ball but misses.

DRINKS BREAK!
Southee drives it just over to the left of the bowler for a single.

On middle and leg, played to mid-wicket.
Pitched around off, defended by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

OUT! 50th ODI wicket for Amit Mishra! Tossed up on middle, Bracewell looks to flick it but doesn't time it right. The ball is lobbed towards short mid-wicket and Ajinkya Rahane waiting there takes a comfortable catch. Mishra is confident in his appeal but the umpires aren't so sure and they send it upstairs. This one is towards mid on off his crease.

On a good length outside off, Latham lets it go through.
Good length outside off, comes in, left alone by Latham.
On a length outside off, comes in, Neesham gets an inside edge behind square leg for a single.
Fuller length outside off, Neesham looks to play at that one and is beaten as he is late to withdraw his bat.

OUT! EASY AS YOU LIKE! Fuller length on off, Ronchi plays it from his crease. He checks his shot at the last moment but the damage has been done and Umesh takes a simple catch at mid on. Ronchi is disappointed but has to walk back. New Zealand in deep trouble!
OUCH! Back of a length ball on middle, Latham looks to work it through the on side but is hit on his pads.

OUT! Umesh strikes again! Hurls it on a good length just outside off, the ball pitches and moves just enough. Taylor has to play at it and gets an outside edge that flies through to the keeper for a simple catch. Umesh and co. appeal but Taylor is walking. This is a perfect start for India!

OUT! Umesh strikes! This is a huge wicket for India as the Kiwi skipper departs! Short ball outside off, Kane frees his arms and slashes at it. The ball goes off the top edge of the bat and goes to Amit Mishra at deep third man who takes a comfortable reverse-cupped catch.
Length ball outside off, punched off the back foot through the off side.
Fullish delivery around off, Latham looks to defend it and gets an inside edge. The ball goes fine down the leg side and the batsmen run a single.

BEATEN! Fuller outside off, the ball nearly shaves the outside edge of Williamson's bat.

Ouch! A touch short on middle at 143 kph, comes in, Latham gets hit on his body.

Action! Latham taps this one towards backward point and Kane is calling him through for a quick single. Latham responds but is a touch late. The fielder though has a shy at the striker's end but misses. No harm done.
Kane Williamson comes out to bat for the Kiwis.

OUT! Maiden ODI wicket for Hardik Pandya in his very first over! On a length outside off, comes in, Guptill pushes at it from his crease. The ball takes the outside edge and flies to Rohit Sharma at second slip. Rohit accepts the catch and Hardik Pandya takes off! Plenty of action in that over from Hardik!
FOUR! Runs are flowing! Short outside off, Guptill slaps it through backward point for a boundary. That was well hit by Guptill.
BEAUTY! Fuller length outside off, Guptill looks to play at it from his crease but is beaten. Good start this from Hardik.
FOUR! NOT IN CONTROL! On a fuller length outside off, Guptill looks to play at first but then lets it go. The ball goes off the bottom edge and runs past second slip for a boundary.
FOUR! EDGED! Full and swinging outside off, Guptill goes for the drive but gets an outside edge through the vacant gully region for a boundary.
Fuller and angling away, Latham pushes at it and gets an outside edge through gully for a single to get off the mark.
Hardik Pandya to bowl from the other end.

BEATEN! Umesh again bowls it outside off, on a fuller length, Guptill looks to play at that one but is beaten.
Nice swing! Fuller and swinging away after pitching, left alone by Guptill.

Inside edge! On a length again, comes in a touch, Guptill defends it with an inside edge.
On a length outside off, left alone by Guptill.
WIDE! Starts off with a fuller length ball but down the leg side. A wide signaled.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. Martin Guptill and Tom Latham are out to open. Umesh Yadav to run in first up...
Time for the national anthems!
NEW ZEALAND XI -  Martin Guptill, Tom Latham, Kane Williamson(c), Ross Taylor, Luke Ronchi(wk), Corey Anderson, James Neesham, Mitchell Santner, Tim Southee, Ish Sodhi, Doug Bracewell.
INDIA XI - Rohit Sharma, Ajinkya Rahane, Virat Kohli, Manish Pandey, Kedar Jadhav, MS Dhoni(wk/c), Hardik Pandya (debut), Axar Patel, Amit Mishra, Umesh Yadav, Jasprit Bumrah.

TOSS -  INDIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO FIELD. The big news is that Hardik Pandya will be making his ODI debut today for India. New Zealand have rested Trent Boult and Matt Henry. Corey Anderson and Tim Southee return to the team for the Kiwis. We will have the playing XI for you in a bit.

Playing their 900th ODI game today, India will have MS Dhoni back and it will be interesting to see how they go about this series with limited games left for them in this format leading up to the Champions Trophy 2017. They have a few youngsters who will be itching to step up and perform at the big stage.

Hello everyone and welcome to the coverage of first ODI of the five-match series between India and New Zealand in Dharamsala. The visitors will hope that the change of formats brings a change of fortune for them. New Zealand will want to ensure they find the right combination for these surfaces which could very well decide how the series pans out.
